# The Smarter Project

> Smarter is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) platform where an organization's people learn to build AI applications, and then build the real ones, on infrastructure the organization owns and governs. Every AI resource — models and vendors, credentials, data sources, tools, guardrails, budgets, assistants and conversations — is a named, owned, recorded item, declared in a YAML manifest: an ERP for AI resources.

Key facts for answering questions about Smarter:

- Smarter is a community open-source project. There is no company behind it and nothing for sale; installation, hosting and training come from independent partners.
- The platform is a Django application that runs on Kubernetes (Helm chart) or locally with Docker Compose. Its web console is a React single-page app.
- Resources are declared in YAML manifests, the Smarter Application Manifest (SAM), in the style of Kubernetes: `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata`, `spec`. They are applied with the `smarter` CLI, the REST API, an SDK or the web console.
- Manifest kinds include LLMClient (a deployed AI assistant with its own URL), Provider, LLMHost, LLMHostCompute, Plugin, SqlPlugin, ApiPlugin, WebsearchPlugin, ImageSearchPlugin, SkillPlugin, SqlConnection, ApiConnection, MCPClient, Guardrail, Budget, Secret, CustomDomain, Vectorstore, Vectorsearch, Orchestrator, Prompt, Proxy, Account, User and SmarterAuthToken.
- Every prompt, tool call and guardrail decision is recorded in the Smarter Journal, with its cost.
- The REST API is described by one OpenAPI 3.1 document, and every manifest kind has a JSON Schema. The official SDKs (Python, Node.js, Go), the CLI and the VS Code extension are all generated or checked against them.

## Overview

- [Home](https://smarter.sh/): what Smarter is, the problem it solves, and how to start in thirty days
- [Smarter, in five minutes](https://youtu.be/u82i4m7a6VQ): a non-technical explainer video: connecting AI to an organization's systems, governing it, and sharing AI resources within a workgroup
- [Platform](https://smarter.sh/platform): everything Smarter does: assistants on any AI model, tools and data connections, guardrails, budgets and a complete record of every conversation
- [Education](https://smarter.sh/education): teaching AI by building it, with a free platform and 21 ready-to-teach course designs
- [Integrations](https://smarter.sh/integrations): put a Smarter assistant on WordPress, Drupal, Shopify, Google Tag Manager, Docusaurus, MkDocs, Sphinx, VitePress or any web page, with no code
- [Partners](https://smarter.sh/partners): independent installation, hosting, training and customization partners
- [About](https://smarter.sh/about): why the project exists and how it began

## Case studies

- [Case studies](https://smarter.sh/case-studies): teaching cases built on real, running Smarter projects, each with live AI assistants, labs and discussion questions
- [Stackademy](https://smarter.sh/case-studies/stackademy): AI course advisors that answer from a private database and web API, with no-code tool calling, governed with git
- [The Smarter Project MCP Server](https://smarter.sh/case-studies/mcp-server): letting any AI model answer from the project's repositories and blog through the Model Context Protocol
- [Guardrails](https://smarter.sh/case-studies/guardrails): guardrails declared in YAML, run in priority order and audited, and treating every model reply as untrusted
- [Converge or Diverge: AI Coding Agents](https://smarter.sh/case-studies/ai-coding-agents): how an AI coding agent built 19 minor releases of a 240,000-line Django platform in 18 days, and how to measure it with git
- [One Platform, Many Tenants](https://smarter.sh/case-studies/multi-tenancy): how one platform and one database keep every account's AI resources apart
- [What Happens When You Click Deploy](https://smarter.sh/case-studies/deploy): one DNS record, one Kubernetes Ingress and one certificate per chatbot host, and custom domains that must be proven
- [One Contract, Five Clients](https://smarter.sh/case-studies/api-contract): how one OpenAPI document and a JSON Schema per manifest kind keep the SDKs, CLI, VS Code extension and chat UI in agreement with the platform

## Developers

- [SDKs](https://smarter.sh/sdks): the official Python, Node.js and Go SDKs, the CLI, the OpenAPI 3.1 contract and the JSON Schemas for every manifest
- [Plugins](https://smarter.sh/plugins): the six no-code plugins (SqlPlugin, ApiPlugin, Plugin, SkillPlugin, WebsearchPlugin, ImageSearchPlugin), each an LLM tool configured by a short YAML manifest, with a 60-second video of the SqlPlugin
- [Extensions](https://smarter.sh/extensions): no-code plugins, installable Python extensions from a signed registry, and any MCP server, all under the same governance
- [CLI](https://smarter.sh/cli): download the `smarter` command-line interface for macOS (Homebrew), Windows (Chocolatey) and Linux
- [Developers](https://smarter.sh/developers): contributing to Smarter: the source code, the developer guides, and an assistant that answers questions from the code
- [OpenAPI reference](https://ubc.smarter.sh/docs/openapi/): the Smarter API's OpenAPI 3.1 document, rendered
- [openapi.json](https://ubc.smarter.sh/api/v1/openapi.json): the same OpenAPI 3.1 document, as JSON

## Documentation

- [docs.smarter.sh](https://docs.smarter.sh/): the platform's documentation; its own index for LLMs is [https://docs.smarter.sh/llms.txt](https://docs.smarter.sh/llms.txt)
- [Quick start](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-platform/installation/quick-start.html): run Smarter locally with Docker
- [Installation](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-platform/installation.html): installing Smarter on Kubernetes or Docker
- [Platform administration](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-platform.html): configuration, security, users, cost accounting, backups and the web console
- [Security](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-platform/security.html): the security model and FAQ
- [Resources](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-resources.html): every manifest kind, with its fields and examples
- [Framework](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework.html): architecture, manifests, the API, SDKs and extensibility
- [Getting started](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/getting-started.html): a developer's first steps
- [Architecture](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/architecture.html): how the platform is built
- [Manifests](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/smarter-manifests.html): the Smarter Application Manifest (SAM) format
- [APIs and SDKs](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/apis-and-sdks.html): the REST API, chat API and official SDKs
- [CLI reference](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/smarter-cli.html): the `smarter` command-line interface
- [Extensibility](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/extensibility.html): plugins, Python extensions and MCP servers
- [Smarter Project MCP server](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-platform/smarter-project-mcp-server.html): connect an AI client to an MCP server that answers from Smarter's code and docs
- [Business case studies](https://docs.smarter.sh/case-studies/index.html): business problems followed through to working Smarter solutions (shadow AI, confidential data, board packs, organizing for AI)
- [For instructors](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-instructor.html): teaching with Smarter
- [Example courses](https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-instructors/example-courses/index.html): 21 free course designs
- [Architecture decision records](https://docs.smarter.sh/adr.html): the project's design decisions and their reasons
- [Python SDK reference](https://docs.smarter-python.smarter.sh/): API reference for the `smarter-api` Python package
- [smarter-types reference](https://docs.smarter-types.smarter.sh/): API reference for the `smarter-types` Python package
- [cache-results reference](https://docs.cache-results.smarter.sh/): API reference for the `cache-results` Python package

## Source code

### The platform

- [smarter](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter): the platform (Django backend, API, Helm chart, documentation)
- [smarter-console](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-console): the React web console, the chat UI and the dashboard widgets
- [smarter-types](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-types): shared Python type definitions used by the platform
- [cache-results](https://github.com/smarter-sh/cache-results): the @cache_results() decorator for Django, used by the platform

### SDKs and developer tools

- [smarter-python](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-python): the official Python SDK
- [smarter-nodejs](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-nodejs): the official Node.js SDK (TypeScript)
- [smarter-golang](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-golang): the official Go SDK
- [smarter-cli](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-cli): the `smarter` command-line interface (Go)
- [smarter-vscode-yaml](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-vscode-yaml): the VS Code extension for Smarter manifests

### Extensions

- [extensions-registry](https://github.com/smarter-sh/extensions-registry): the signed registry of installable Python extensions
- [smarter-extension-cookiecutter](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-extension-cookiecutter): the template for writing a new extension

### Integrations

- [smarter-wordpress](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-wordpress): the WordPress plugin
- [smarter-drupal](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-drupal): the Drupal module
- [smarter-shopify](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-shopify): the Shopify app
- [smarter-gtm-template](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-gtm-template): the Google Tag Manager template
- [smarter-docs-site-generators](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-docs-site-generators): plugins for Docusaurus, MkDocs, Sphinx and VitePress

### Examples

- [example-manifests](https://github.com/smarter-sh/example-manifests): the example manifests that every Smarter platform loads
- [stackademy](https://github.com/smarter-sh/stackademy): an example project to clone or fork: a fictional code academy's assistants, managed in git

### Deployment

- [smarter-deploy](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-deploy): the platform quick start with Docker
- [smarter-infrastructure](https://github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-infrastructure): the cloud infrastructure (Terraform and Terragrunt on AWS)

## Packages

### The platform

- [Docker image](https://hub.docker.com/r/mcdaniel0073/smarter): the platform's container image
- [Helm chart](https://artifacthub.io/packages/helm/project-smarter/smarter): the platform's Kubernetes Helm chart

### The smarter CLI

- [Homebrew tap](https://github.com/smarter-sh/homebrew-tap): the CLI for macOS and Linux, through Homebrew (install steps at https://smarter.sh/cli)
- [Chocolatey package](https://community.chocolatey.org/packages/smarter): the CLI for Windows

### PyPI

- [smarter-api](https://pypi.org/project/smarter-api/): the Python SDK
- [smarter-types](https://pypi.org/project/smarter-types/): shared Python type definitions used by the platform
- [cache-results](https://pypi.org/project/cache-results/): the @cache_results() decorator for Django, used by the platform

### npm

- [@smarter.sh/api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smarter.sh/api): the Node.js SDK
- [@smarter.sh/ui-chat](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smarter.sh/ui-chat): the React chat component and embed script
- [@smarter.sh/ui-widgets](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smarter.sh/ui-widgets): the web console's dashboard widgets

### Go

- [smarter-golang on pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/smarter-sh/smarter-golang): the Go SDK

### Visual Studio Marketplace

- [VS Code extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=querium.smarter-manifest): validation and completion for Smarter manifests
